business_requirement.summary: After clicking the submit button the customer sees a loader while the request is processed; the button is blocked during processing; when the request finishes the button unblocks and the customer receives a toast with the result.

expected_behavior.description: immediately after click, a loader indicating request processing is visible
while the request is in flight, the button is blocked (not clickable)
when the request finishes (success or failure), the button unblocks
when the request finishes, the loader disappears
when the request finishes, the customer receives a toast describing the result (success or failure)

edge_cases.description: customer clicks the button again while a request is in flight
request takes a long time to finish

forbidden_behavior.description: a second request is sent while one is already in flight
button remains blocked after the request has finished
request finishes without any toast shown to the customer

assumptions.description: clicks during an in-flight request are ignored (not queued)
no client-side timeout is applied; the request settles when the transport settles

open_questions.question: Should clicks during processing be queued or ignored?
Is there a timeout after which the request counts as failed?
